verdict.rationale: The only bulk-style capability in the evidence is backfilling months of historical data into Sift (sift-docs-4). Workflows (sift-docs-6, sift-docs-12) automate risk decisions, but they run per event in real time rather than as user-initiated bulk actions. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch endpoints for decisions or labels, bulk actions across many users or orders in the console or Review Queues, batch API limits and semantics, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
